add_definitions(
    -DWIN32)

include_directories(
    ${REACTOS_SOURCE_DIR}/vendor/libmpg123/include)

spec2def(l3codeca.acm l3codeca.acm.spec)

# l3codeca.acm is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/l3codeca_acm-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
add_library(l3codeca.acm_shims OBJECT mpegl3.c)
target_link_libraries(l3codeca.acm_shims PRIVATE wine libmpg123 oldnames libshlwapi libwinmm libuser32 libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
set_wine_module_fixme(l3codeca.acm_shims) # CORE-5743: No ARRAY_SIZE macro
add_cargo_module(l3codeca.acm l3codeca_acm-cargo l3codeca.acm
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS l3codeca.acm_shims psdk)
